definitions.explanation: refers to any person without exception, or all people in a given context

examples.japanese: {誰|だれ}でも{参加|さんか}できます。
{誰|だれ}でも{間違|まちが}いはある。
{誰|だれ}でもいいから{手伝|てつだ}ってほしい。
examples.english: I want anyone at all to help me.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{誰|だれ} (who) + でも (even, any)

PATTERN:
The ~でも pattern creates "any-" words:
- {何|なん}でも - anything
- {何処|どこ}でも - anywhere
- いつでも - anytime
- どちらでも - either one

NUANCE:
- With positive: "anyone can" → universal possibility
- With negative: "not anyone" → nobody
- {誰|だれ}でもいい - anyone is fine (indifference)

CONTRAST:
- {誰|だれ}でも (anyone/everyone) ↔ {誰|だれ}か (someone)
- {誰|だれ}でも (anyone/everyone) ↔ {誰|だれ}も + neg (no one)
